zh.title: 台灣虎航開航高雄往返石垣島與小松雙航線
zh.summary: 台灣虎航開航高雄往返石垣島與小松航線；自高雄出發航線增至14條
body: 台灣虎航於2026年9月2日在高雄國際機場（KHH）舉行開航儀式，開航高雄往返石垣島與高雄往返小松兩條新航線。
隨著這兩條航線投入營運，台灣虎航自高雄出發的日本航線增加至11條，高雄出發總航線數則由12條增至14條，另包含首爾金浦、濟州島及峴港等航線。
台灣虎航董事長黃世惠指出，目前桃園往返石垣島與小松航線皆已穩定營運，開通高雄航線可便利南台灣旅客並吸引日籍旅客利用雙點進出體驗台灣。
黃世惠預計於9月3日搭乘首航班前往小松出席當地開航活動，並將拜會石川縣知事山野之義。

en.title: Taiwan Tigerair Launches Kaohsiung Routes to Ishigaki and Komatsu
en.summary: Taiwan Tigerair launches Kaohsiung flights to Ishigaki and Komatsu, expanding its Kaohsiung network to 14 routes.
body: Taiwan Tigerair held a launch ceremony at Kaohsiung International Airport (KHH) on September 2, 2026, marking the inauguration of two new routes connecting Kaohsiung with Ishigaki and Komatsu in Japan.

The addition of the Ishigaki and Komatsu services increases the airline's routes departing from Kaohsiung from 12 to 14, with Japanese destinations expanding to 11. Taiwan Tigerair's Kaohsiung network also includes services to Seoul Gimpo, Jeju Island, and Da Nang.

Taiwan Tigerair Chairman Huang Shih-hui stated that routes from Taoyuan to Ishigaki and Komatsu are already operating stably. He noted that the new Kaohsiung services enhance convenience for southern Taiwan travelers and benefit Japanese visitors.
Huang is scheduled to board the inaugural flight to Komatsu on September 3 to attend local launch events and meet with Ishikawa Prefecture Governor Yamano Toshiyuki.

zh.title: 紐約甘迺迪機場加油車擦撞中國國際航空波音747-8機翼致燃油外洩
zh.summary: 中國國際航空一架波音747-8在紐約甘迺迪機場遭加油車破壞；燃油洩漏至停機坪。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，於美國紐約甘迺迪國際機場（JFK），一輛地面加油車造成一架中國國際航空（Air China）波音 747-8 型客機受損。事件發生期間，航空燃油自該架客機的機翼位置持續傾瀉湧出。
現場紀錄影像顯示，該輛加油車在運作移動時，自該架處於停放狀態的波音 747-8 客機上拉扯並強行扯斷了連接的加油軟管線路。
加油軟管遭扯斷後，大量的航空燃油隨即自機體洩漏，並噴濺撒落至甘迺迪國際機場的停機坪地面區域。

en.title: Air China Boeing 747-8 Damaged by Fuel Truck at New York JFK
en.summary: An Air China Boeing 747-8 was damaged by a fuel truck at New York JFK, spilling fuel.
body: According to news reporting from Simple Flying, an Air China Boeing 747-8 passenger aircraft was damaged by a ground fuel truck at John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) in New York. Jet fuel was observed pouring directly from the aircraft wing during the incident.
Video footage recorded at the airport shows the fuel truck ripping hoses away from the parked Boeing 747-8 aircraft as the vehicle operated on the ground.
After the fuel hoses were forcibly ripped away from the parked plane, jet fuel spilled across the apron at John F. Kennedy International Airport.

zh.title: 烏克蘭總統警告航空公司俄羅斯領空安全日已結束
zh.summary: 烏克蘭警告航空公司俄領空不再安全；俄方反駁為國家恐怖主義；航空營運仍正常維持
body: 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基於2026年9月1日發表聲明，警告行經俄羅斯領空的所有航空公司、保險公司及使用俄國主要機場者，俄國領空的安全時期已經結束。澤倫斯基表示，烏克蘭並未對民用航空構成直接威脅，但俄羅斯上空將出現大規模無人機活動，各方必須予以考量。
針對烏克蘭方面的警告，俄羅斯總統普丁回應表示，該份聲明屬於國家恐怖主義的宣布。
儘管烏克蘭提出警告，據航班追蹤網站Flightradar24數據顯示，截至2026年9月2日，俄羅斯上空的航空交通仍維持正常，包括阿聯酋航空與土耳其航空在內的國內外航空公司均持續在該領空營運。

en.title: Ukraine Warns Airlines over Russian Airspace as Drones Expand Operation
en.summary: Ukraine warns airlines over Russian airspace risks, while Flightradar24 shows normal commercial operations continuing.
body: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy issued a warning on September 1, 2026, to airlines, insurers, and entities using Russian airspace and key airports, stating that safe days in Russia's skies are over. He emphasized that Ukraine does not threaten civil aircraft, but noted that drone activity in Russian airspace will reach a scale that operators must take into account.
In response to the warning, Russian President Vladimir Putin characterized Zelenskyy's statement as a declaration of state terrorism.

Despite the statement, air travel over Russia appeared to continue normally on September 2, 2026. Data from Flightradar24 indicated that domestic and international carriers, including Emirates and Turkish Airlines, were continuing operations in the airspace.

zh.title: 台灣贈無人機予帛琉等友邦 促進人才培訓與技術合作
zh.summary: 外交部長林佳龍於帛琉致贈友邦無人機；深化技術應用與產業合作
body: 外交部長林佳龍於2026年8月27日至9月3日率團前往帛琉共和國，出席第55屆「太平洋島國論壇」（PIF）峰會相關活動。林佳龍於9月1日出席「帛琉台灣之夜」活動，與來自帛琉、馬紹爾群島、吐瓦魯及關島的友人交流，並向友邦致贈無人機。
活動期間，台灣「國際青年大使」也在帛琉進行無人機展演。林佳龍指出，希望透過致贈無人機，進一步深化人才培訓、技術應用與產業合作，讓科技真正回應太平洋國家的發展需求。
帛琉總統惠恕仁於致詞時表示，友誼建立在信任之上，帛琉會繼續與台灣並肩同行，並期待雙方友誼持續延伸至整個太平洋地區。

en.title: Taiwan Gifts Drones to Pacific Allies to Deepen Technical Cooperation
en.summary: Taiwan Minister Lin Chia-lung gifts drones in Palau; aims to deepen technical and industrial cooperation.
body: Taiwan Minister of Foreign Affairs Lin Chia-lung led a delegation to Palau from August 27 to September 3, 2026, to attend activities related to the 55th Pacific Islands Forum summit. During the Palau Taiwan Night on September 1, Lin interacted with guests from Palau, the Marshall Islands, Tuvalu, and Guam, and presented drones to diplomatic allies.

Taiwanese Youth Ambassadors also conducted drone demonstrations in Palau during the visit. Lin stated that gifting the drones aims to further deepen talent training, technical applications, and industrial cooperation, allowing technology to address the development needs of Pacific nations.

Palau President Surangel Whipps Jr. stated during the event that friendship is built on trust and expressed appreciation for Taiwan partnership, hoping the relationship between the two nations will continue to extend across the Pacific.

zh.title: 德國指控俄羅斯策劃萊比錫機場（LEJ）無人機襲擊並關閉領事館
zh.summary: 德國聯邦政府指控俄羅斯策劃萊比錫機場無人機襲擊；宣佈關閉俄國駐波昂總領事館。
body: 德國聯邦政府於2026年9月1日宣佈，將2026年8月4日發生於德國萊比錫/哈雷機場的無人機襲擊未遂事件歸咎於俄羅斯。德國聯邦內政部長亞歷山大·多布林特（Alexander Dobrindt）指出，根據警方調查結果、案發模式以及德國情報機關與合作夥伴的情報研判，共同證實了俄羅斯對該起針對停泊貨機的攻擊事件負有責任。

根據 AeroTime 報導，該起事件發生於2026年8月4日當地時間約19時30分，一架載有炸藥的無人機飛向停泊於萊比錫/哈雷機場管制區內的烏克蘭安托諾夫航空（Antonov Airlines）安托諾夫An-124貨機，並撞擊其翼部。撞擊時爆炸物分離，但引信未能成功起爆。調查人員隨後在機場西側的卡貝爾斯克塔爾（Kabelsketal）農田收回了第三架無人機及約50公克的黑索金（hexogen）高能炸藥。
針對該起安全事件，德國聯邦檢察總長辦公室已於2026年8月6日自德勒斯登檢察官手中接管此案，目前正朝向意圖引爆爆炸物及危險干擾航空交通罪名方向進行刑事調查。多布林特部長表示，現場收繳的技術裝置表現出高度專業性，顯示出規劃與執行過程具備高度專業知識及相當規模的組織投入，最終執行則由低階人員實施。
為回應此起事件，德國聯邦外交部長約翰·瓦德普爾（Johann Wadephul）宣佈外交反制措施，包括俄羅斯駐德國波昂（Bonn）的總領事館將於2026年9月18日關閉，並終止位於柏林的俄羅斯文化機構合約。瓦德普爾表示，德國將加強對俄羅斯公民的入境管制，並提議歐盟對相關個人實施新制裁。俄羅斯外交部發言人瑪麗亞·扎哈羅娃（Maria Zakharova）對此回應表示，莫斯科當局將採取對等回應措施。

en.title: Germany Blames Russia for Drone Attack at Leipzig Airport, Orders Consulate Closure
en.summary: Germany attributed an attempted drone attack at Leipzig Airport to Russia; orders consulate closure in Bonn.
body: Germany's federal government announced on September 1, 2026, that it has officially attributed an attempted explosive drone attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport (LEJ) in Germany to Russia. Federal Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt stated that police investigation results, the pattern of the offense, and intelligence findings from German security services and international partners together established Russian responsibility for the August 4, 2026, security incident.

According to reporting by AeroTime, the incident occurred at approximately 19:30 local time on August 4, 2026, when a drone flew toward a parked Antonov Airlines Antonov An-124 cargo aircraft inside the secured area of Leipzig/Halle Airport. The drone struck one of the aircraft's wings, causing the explosive charge to separate upon impact, though the detonator failed to function. Investigators later recovered a third drone along with roughly 50 grams of the explosive hexogen from a field in Kabelsketal, west of the airport.

The Federal Prosecutor General's office took over the criminal investigation from Dresden prosecutors on August 6, 2026, focusing on allegations of attempting to cause an explosion and dangerous interference with air traffic. Dobrindt described the technical configuration recovered at the site as professional, indicating significant technical expertise and organizational planning, while noting that the execution of the attempt was carried out by low-level agents.

In response to the incident, Federal Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul announced a series of diplomatic measures, including the closure of Russia's last operating consulate general in Bonn, Germany, effective September 18, 2026. Germany will also terminate the contract for the Russian House cultural institute in Berlin, tighten entry controls for Russian nationals, and propose new EU sanctions. Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova stated that Moscow intends to respond in kind to the diplomatic actions.
